Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 or FIX.4.4 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by BATS for messages sent to BATS. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to TRF ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the BATS test system. PROD for messages sent to the BATS production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. BATS does not support PossResend (97) = Y on the TRF system.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to BATS. Must be identifier known to BATS.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in DeliverToSubID (129).

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. If enabled at the port or firm level, timestamps will be sent with microsecond resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from BATS. Must be BATS approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by BATS for the given symbol.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: This field must not be supplied on trade reports to the TRF.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by BATS TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Traded price.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional. Indicates the date and time the trade took place.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Optional. If specified, must match the date component of TransactTime (60).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Used when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) to identify a specific market. If present must be a valid Reuters exchange code or ISO MIC code. For TDM and SI trade reports, may optionally be left blank to use the primary line as designated by BATS.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new, a cancellation, an amendment or a release. Trades reported under the TDM service may be cancelled or amended by the participant. Trades that are currently being delayed from publication can be released for immediate publication. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel 2 = Replace 3 = Release

Field.Name: PreviouslyReported
Field.Description: Indicates this trade was previously reported. N or missing means it was not previously reported and should be printed on the market data feed. Y means it was previously reported and should not be printed.

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the TradeReportID matches a live trade report (one that has been acked, but not confirmed or declined), it will be rejected as duplicate. Note: BATS only enforces the uniqueness of TradeRepor- tID values among currently live trade reports. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your TradeReportID val- ues day unique.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Where VenueType (1430) = X (offbook), this field models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field, and takes the following values: 1 = Trade Reporting (Off-Exchange) 3 = Trade Reporting (On-Exchange) 9 = Trade Reporting (Systematic Internalizer)

Field.Name: TradingSessionSubID
Field.Description: Models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field for scenarios where Venue- Type (1430) is not ‘X’ (offbook). Use MatchType (574) instead, where VenueType (1430) = X. The following are valid values: 2 = Scheduled Opening Auction 4 = Scheduled Closing Auction 6 = Scheduled Intraday Auction (9) = Unscheduled Auction 3 = Continuous Trading 5 = Post Trading (10) = Out of Main Session Trading Note: Values 9 and 10 are not yet in a FIX standard, but have been pro- posed by the FPL EMEA Trade Data Standardisation Working Group for this purpose.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.1 field ‘Transaction Cate- gory’. O = Regular Trade (aka Plain-Vanilla Trade) 30 = Special price (aka Trade with Conditions) 59 = Dark Trade 60 = Technical Trade 61 = Give-up / Give-in trade

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.3 field ‘Crossing Trade Indicator’. Agency Cross trades may be indicated by setting Trd- SubType (829) = 37. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark Indicator’. Benchmark trades may be indicated by setting Secondary- TrdType (855) = 58. Other values are invalid. Note: SecondaryTrdType (855) = 58 is not yet in a FIX standard, but has been proposed by the FPL EMA Trade Data Standardisation Working Group for this purpose.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Must be 0 (Submit)

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Used to specify a previously reported trade to be amended, cancelled or released. Mandatory when TradeReportTransType (487) = 1, 2 or 3, must be absent when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Must be 1 (Two-Party Report)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 4 field ’Publication Mode’, and is used by the participant to request that the publication be delayed. It is ignored if the trade does not qualify for delayed publication. This field may not be amended, however trades currently being delayed may be released prior to their maximum delay duration using TradeRe- portTransType (487) = 3. Supported values: 1 = Publish trade (immediately) 2 = Deferred Publication TradePublishIndicator (1390) is optional, and defaults to 1.

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of venue on which this trade occurred. This field models the MMT Level 1 field ‘Market Mechanism’, and has the following possible values: B = Central Limit Order Book Q = Quote Driven Market D = Dark Order Book X = OffBook

Field.Name: NoTradePriceConditions
Field.Description: If present, can only take value 1, and indicates the presence of a single TradePriceCondition (1839) field.

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the ex/cum dividend state of the trade. This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.6 ‘Ex/Cum Dividend Indi- cator’. Supported values are: 0 = Cum Dividend 2 = Ex Dividend

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the method by which the trade was exe- cuted. This field corresponds to the proposed MMT Level 3.7 ‘Execution Method’. The following values are supported: 0 = Unspecified (default) 1 = Manual 2 = Automated

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Mandatory unique ID chosen by client for a Quote or QuoteCancel. 18 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Note: BATS only enforces the uniqueness of QuoteID values among currently live quotes. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your QuoteID values day unique.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by BATS TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Used when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) to identify a specific market. If present must be a valid Reuters exchange code or ISO MIC code. For TDM and SI trade reports, may optionally be left blank to use the primary line as designated by BATS.

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: Specifies the bid quote price. If omitted, indicates the bid quote is not to be changed, and BidSize (134) must also be omitted. If BidPx (132) = 0, indicates the bid quote is to be cancelled, and BidSize (134) = 0 must also be present.

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: Specifies the offer quote price. If omitted, indicates the offer quote is not to be changed, and OfferSize (135) must also be omitted. If OfferPx (133) = 0, indicates the offer quote is to be cancelled, and OfferSize (135) = 0 must also be present.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: The quantity of the bid quote. Must be zero when cancelling a quote.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: The quantity of the offer (ask) quote. Must be zero when cancelling a quote.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by BATS for the given symbol.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Mandatory unique ID chosen by client for a Quote or QuoteCancel. 18 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Note: BATS only enforces the uniqueness of QuoteID values among currently live quotes. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your QuoteID values day unique.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Supported values: 1 = Cancel for Symbol 4 = Cancel for All Quotes This field is optional, and defaults to 1. When QuoteCancelType (298) = 4, the request will be acknowledged with one QuoteStatusReport message for each existing quote.

Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Reason codes are: A = Admin D = Duplicate TradeReportID m = Market Access Risk Limit Exceeded Y = Symbol Not Supported Z = Unforseen Reason

Field.Description: Unique identifier for the trade report confirm as provided by BATS

Field.Name: TradeReportRefID
Field.Description: Contains the TradeReportID of the original trade capture report to which this message relates

Field.Name: MatchStatus
Field.Description: Will be 0 (Matched) for confirm, and 1 (Unmatched) for a decline

Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Accept) for a confirm, 3 (Decline) for a decline and 0 (Submit) for an unsolicited change.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Id representing the trade, as seen on outbound market data. Allocated by BATS. Required to amend, cancel or release a report.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Will be 0 (Trade Confirmation)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Deferred Publication) if deferment is requested and the trade is eligible for such. Otherwise, will be 1 (Publish trade (immediately))

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: Indicates the time at which a deferred trade report will be automatically published. Where RptTime falls outside of the systems operating time, the report will be published during operating hours on the next trading day. When no deferral is requested, or when the trade does not qualify for a deferral, any time returned will match TransactTime (60).

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Copied from the corresponding Quote / QuoteCancel, if applicable. Unsolicited QuoteStatus messages can be sent due to system events, and in such circumstances, QuoteID may be omitted.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Quote/QuoteCancel, if present.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Quote/QuoteCancel, if present.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Quote/QuoteCancel, if present.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Quote/QuoteCancel, if present.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Quote/QuoteCancel, if present.

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: For valid Quote messages (QuoteStatus (297) = 0 or 1), the new price and size fields are returned in the corresponding QuoteStatus message. These may be zero if there is no applicable quote on this side. Typically, these will match the values sent in the corresponding Quote, unless that Quote message opted to change one side of the quote only.

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: The quote’s offer price, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: The quote’s bid quantity, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: The quote’s offer quantity, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: QuoteStatus
Field.Description: Indicates the acceptance or otherwise of a Quote or QuoteCancel mes- sage. 0: Accepted - indicates acceptance of a Quote message. 1: Cancelled - sent in respose to a successful QuoteCancel message. 5: Rejected - sent in respose to a Quote or QuoteCancel message, indi- cating the message could not be accepted.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates a reason the applicable Quote or QuoteCancel mes- sage could not be accepted.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must be first field in repeating-group 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 8 = Cross

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Reflected back on Trade Capture Report confirmed and declined messages. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126).

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be D (Proprietary / Custom Code)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, this field is mandatory on trades reported to the TRF, and must be specified as PartyRole (452) = 7.

Field.Name: NoPartyIDs
Field.Description: Must always be 1

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The BATS Participant ID (4 uppercase letters).

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Optional. A = Agency P = Principal (default) R = Riskless

Field.Name: CentralCounterparty
Field.Description: The CCP handling this trade leg for a confirm, and not present for a decline: NONE = No Clearing

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by BATS TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is in- cluded when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by BATS for the given symbol.
